extracted.intended_audience: design students, exhibition-stand designers, architects, makers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for designing and constructing a quick, multipurpose exhibition stand using foam board and aluminium channels, emphasizing structural technique, edge treatment, and aesthetics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use tensile strength of foam board
rubrics_metrics.description: Made by using the tensile strength of foam board, Prisma is a three-faced structural element, which can be used for multiple purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage the material property (tensile strength) of foam board as the primary load-bearing strategy; design the form (three-faced element) so the boards work together structurally and serve multiple functions (display, support, partition).

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-faced structural element
rubrics_metrics.description: Prisma is a three-faced structural element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt a three-faced (triangular/prismatic) geometry to create a stable, self-supporting unit; this form contributes to rigidity and multipurpose use (e.g., shelving, partition, stand).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bind edges of three foam boards to form a rigid structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The beauty of the detail of this structure lies in binding the edges of three foam boards to form a rigid structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edge-binding technique is key — join the boards at their edges precisely to transform flexible panels into a rigid structural element; attention to the edge detail is both structural and aesthetic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use aluminium channel to bind and finish edges
rubrics_metrics.description: The aluminium channel binds the foam board structure and gives a finish to the edges of the stand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply aluminium channeling along joined edges to clamp and protect the foam board seams while providing a neat finished look; channels serve both functional (binding) and aesthetic (edge finish) roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quick solution / ease of construction
rubrics_metrics.description: It is a quick solution for an exhibition stand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize simple, fast fabrication and assembly methods suitable for rapid deployment at exhibitions; choose materials and joinery (foam board + aluminium channels) that enable quick on-site setup and teardown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multipurpose usability
rubrics_metrics.description: Prisma ... can be used for multiple purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design the stand as a versatile element that can serve several display or functional roles (e.g., signage, shelving, partitioning), increasing utility for different exhibition needs.
